title: Radiomics analysis of peri-implant bone alterations after dental implant fracture
html: Dental implant fracture is a serious mechanical complication that may induce local bone alterations. This study aimed to characterize peri-implant bone morphology following implant fracture using computed tomography (CT)-based texture analysis (TA). CT data from 18 patients with dental implant fractures and 18 patients with normal implants (controls) were analysed. A total of 279 radiomics features were extracted from the jawbone around the dental implant in both groups and analysed using MaZda version 3.3.
